issues.text: "this round's ... IEmailSender" implies a per-round instance, and the sentence credits both services with bringing the fresh DbContext. At stage-2 IEmailSender is registered once as a single instance (AddSingleton<IEmailSender>(new MailKitEmailSender(smtp))); only NotificationQueue (scoped, constructor takes DonHangDbContext) carries the round's DbContext. Meta claim 7 has the same wording.
